resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Bath County, Virginia, inside the Monongahela National Forest. Forest Lookouts says Highland County. The story reports the register's county and notes the Forest Lookouts listing.
The register gives a 40-foot tower. A 1941 federal survey description says about 50 feet high with a glass-enclosed cab on top. The story gives the register's figure and reports the survey's.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. The county conflict (Bath per register, Highland per Forest Lookouts and its Virginia index) and the height conflict (40 ft register vs about 50 ft in a 1941 survey note) are both reported in the story. No removal date appears in any source, so no removed event is recorded. No source describes the site today. Two web searches; a Facebook group post claims removal and 'highest point in Bath County' but is not used. The brief's Bath County is supported by the register, so it is not corrected.
